zh-Hans: 无论如何，都不能在这里被超！
en: Whatever happens, I can't let him pass me here!

zh-Hans: 从右边来，还是左边？这种时候，这小车身反倒不好用了！
en: From the right, or the left? At a time like this, this little body isn't much use!

zh-Hans: 比赛才刚开始。希望你那种危险的走钢丝，能一直撑到最后！
en: The battle's only just begun. Let's hope you can keep that dangerous tightrope act up to the end!

zh-Hans: 冷静点，总之现在得冷静下来。
en: Calm down. Above all, I need to stay calm.

zh-Hans: 一着急乱了节奏，可是致命的！
en: Panic and lose my rhythm, and I'm done for!

zh-Hans: 难道他比我冒了更大的险，把安全余量压得更小？！
en: Is he taking even bigger risks than me, cutting his safety margin even finer?!

zh-Hans: 我也在摸索前轮那点不踏实的抓地，已经拼到极限，不能再快了！
en: I'm feeling for what little front grip I have and pushing to the limit. I can't go any faster!

zh-Hans: 我害怕了！这不是道理，是本能，已经在拼命亮红灯了！
en: I'm scared! It's not logic. It's instinct, flashing red that I'm at my limit!

zh-Hans: 今天我状态不好？这种窝囊样，我绝不能认！
en: I'm off my game today? I won't accept an excuse for driving this badly!

zh-Hans: 他难道不懂害怕？我可怕得很，这雨里 FR 也太不稳定了！
en: Doesn't he feel fear? I sure do! An FR is far too unstable in this rain!

zh-Hans: 搞不懂，为什么下雨还能这么快？
en: I don't get it. How can you be this fast in the rain?

zh-Hans: 你这家伙，是怪物吗？！
en: Are you some kind of monster?!

zh-Hans: 切！
en: Tch!

zh-Hans: 我都说了，开什么玩笑！
en: I said, you've got to be kidding me!

zh-Hans: 可恶，你到底是什么来头？！
en: Damn it! Just what the hell are you?!

zh-Hans: 不可能，绝对不可能！
en: Impossible! It can't be!

zh-Hans: 可恶！
en: Gah!

zh-Hans: 开什么玩笑！
en: You've got to be kidding!

zh-Hans: 不可能！
en: Impossible!

zh-Hans: 好快，太快了！
en: Fast! He's so fast!

zh-Hans: 这到底是什么人！
en: What a driver!

zh-Hans: 那种速度，到底怎么回事？！
en: What the hell is that speed?!

zh-Hans: 这家伙，竟然在这种雨天烂路上跑得游刃有余！
en: He's flying through these awful wet roads like they're nothing!

zh-Hans: 太快了！那家伙根本就跟我们不一样！
en: He's too fast! There's something fundamentally different about him!

zh-Hans: 贴得再紧也超不了我。改成守住不输的战术就行！
en: No matter how close he gets, he can't pass. I'll switch to a strategy that keeps me from losing!

zh-Hans: 从刚才起，感觉就很不对劲。
en: I've had a bad feeling for a while now.

zh-Hans: 他要动手的气息越来越强，开什么玩笑！
en: I can feel him getting ready to make a move. Damn it!

zh-Hans: 不过，他还真能跟啊！
en: Still, he really knows how to keep up!

zh-Hans: 隔着一段距离，像是快甩掉了，却怎么都甩不掉。
en: There's a gap, and it feels like I should shake him. But I can't.

zh-Hans: 被咬住了？！
en: He's on me?!

zh-Hans: 与其等失控的转向不足，不如一开始就做出能控制的转向过度！
en: Better to set up controllable oversteer from the start than wait for uncontrollable understeer!

zh-Hans: 有本事，就跟上来！
en: Keep up if you can!

zh-Hans: 我也有我的骄傲！
en: I've got my own pride!

zh-Hans: 抱歉，不会再让你到前面了！
en: Sorry, but you're not taking the lead again!

zh-Hans: 这种雨里，你不可能再调整回来！
en: In this rain, you won't be able to recover!

zh-Hans: 别想那些没用的，老老实实待在那儿就好！
en: Forget your little schemes and stay right there!

zh-Hans: 呵呵呵……
en: Heh-heh-heh...

zh-Hans: 我不会输！
en: I won't lose!

zh-Hans: 别小看我！
en: Don't underestimate me!

zh-Hans: 拿下了！
en: Got you!

zh-Hans: 什么嘛，根本用不着我出马。
en: What a joke. I didn't even need to come out for this.

zh-Hans: 在专跑恶劣路面的拉力世界里，四轮漂移可是基本功！
en: In rallying, where rough roads are the norm, four-wheel drifting is standard!
